name: Text Editing
scope: Creation and editing of plain textual documents independent of a specific editor.
knowledge: A text-editing task requires an editable document surface.
Creating a new document and entering text are distinct semantic operations.
Clearing all text is a distinct semantic operation from setting non-empty text.
planning_rules: Use NEW_DOCUMENT when the user asks to create a new document.
Use INPUT(text=...) for text the user explicitly asks to enter.
Use CLEAR when the user explicitly asks to erase or clear all text from the editable surface.
